soft_concerns.message: The iter0 hard defect (Step 7 covering only 3 of 8 computation types) is structurally resolved: all 8 types now have concrete per-formula verification methods in Step 7, formula selection routing in Step 6, and broadened activation triggers. However, per R-officeqa-coverage-006 and R-officeqa-computation-001, behavioral impact and numeric precision cannot be verified from skill text alone when baseline is empty. Oracle execution is needed to confirm the candidate actually changes actor behavior and produces correct results.

Items q114 and q123 appear in expected_coverage but are not assigned to any trajectory cluster in the manifest. This is a minor manifest gap, not a hard defect, since both items have coverage evidence referencing real skill steps.

R-officeqa-computation-005 [soft]: The candidate adds structural separation (per-formula routing and verification) addressing prior D feedback, but structural correctness does not prove behavioral change. The r2 false_accept precedent showed that well-structured skills produced 0 improvement and identical results to baseline. Oracle is needed to confirm this round's structural fix translates to behavioral improvement.
